newDeviceBody:
Your Neto account was signed in from a new device: {device} (network {ip}).

If this was not you, change your password and sign out all devices in Settings → Security.
passwordChangedBody:
The password for your Neto account was changed and other devices were signed out.

If this was not you, reset your password on the sign-in page right away.
totpEnabledBody: Two-step verification is now on for your Neto account. Keep your backup codes somewhere safe.
totpDisabledBody: Two-step verification was turned off for your Neto account. If this was not you, change your password and turn it back on.
deletionRequestedSubject: Your Neto account will be deleted
deletionRequestedBody:
Deletion of your Neto account was requested. Your data will be permanently deleted on {date}.

To cancel, just sign in before that date.
deletionCancelledBody: You signed in to your Neto account, so the requested deletion was cancelled. Your data stays.
